items.name: Aqua infant
items.review: The aqua wrapping preserves the first infant identity. Broad blue-green folds and a clear brown forelock replace fine fabric and facial rendering; a round calm face and closed swaddle remain readable.
items.held_pose_review: Direct native1280x720 and1600x720 held fits: simple face and swaddle are readable beside the250px care body, with the painted visible foot resting on the measured hand socket. This is source-only static fitting, not a passed live action.
